subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's opt-in `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` config surface for stranded `message_tool_only` finals, or prefer the no-new-config default-recovery direction in #99536?
rationale: Both directions change a privacy-sensitive delivery boundary: this PR preserves current default behavior but grows public config, while #99536 avoids a knob but changes default recovery behavior.

options.title: Repair opt-in path first
options.body: Move retry identity off `summaryLine`, then keep this PR as the candidate only if maintainers want explicit opt-in recovery.

options.title: Prefer #99536 default recovery
options.body: Use the successor PR after mergeability and proof are clean if maintainers want guarded recovery by default without adding `messages.strandedReplyRecovery`.

options.title: Keep warning-only behavior
options.body: Reject recovery and keep current main's metadata-only warning as the supported `message_tool_only` behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair opt-in path first
recommendation.body: Move retry identity off `summaryLine`, then keep this PR as the candidate only if maintainers want explicit opt-in recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle merged the warning-only baseline and is the strongest history signal for the privacy/delivery policy decision.
